mapper.sql: id, title, content, notification_type, source_type, source_id, sender_id, sender_name, recipient_id, is_read, read_time, status, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_notification SET is_read = 1, read_time = NOW() WHERE recipient_id = #{recipientId} AND deleted = 0 AND is_read = 0
mapper.select: SELECT n.id, n.title, n.content, n.notification_type, n.source_type, n.source_id, n.is_read, n.create_time, n.sender_id, sender.real_name AS sender_name, senderDept.name AS sender_dept_name, n.recipient_id, recipient.real_name AS recipient_name, recipientDept.name AS recipient_dept_name FROM sys_notification n INNER JOIN sys_user sender ON n.sender_id = sender.id INNER JOIN sys_user recipient ON n.recipient_id = recipient.id LEFT JOIN sys_dept senderDept ON sender.dept_id = senderDept.id LEFT JOIN sys_dept recipientDept ON recipient.dept_id = recipientDept.id WHERE n.source_id = #{instanceId} AND n.deleted = 0 AND n.notification_type = 'MENTION' ORDER BY n.create_time DESC
